notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes:
Thanks for purchasing our game, here's what we plan to add in future updates:
- fix visual and gameplay bugs, like map, fish issues
- add new mission/goals
- we work on new point of interests, hidden locations
- redesign UI for support better controller user experience, add achievements
